title: 月光雕刻师 8：只多了一点
description: 别人看着，我一直练习。六个小时以后，终于有了一点变化。 Revised with continuous training, fitted reaction shots, and optional hall ambience and sword impacts.

Hyun.name: 李贤 · Lee Hyun
Hyun.provenance: Approved Hyun B and expression refinement, imagegen concept references 2026-10-14. Translated by hand into articulated SVG: angular cheeks, layered hair, family warmth and eager reward expressions. Original fictional interpretation, not official art.

Instructor.name: 教官 · Instructor
Instructor.provenance: Original fictional Training Hall instructor, shared polished SVG character; not official artwork.

Dummy.name: 稻草人 · Training dummy
Dummy.provenance: Original hand-authored vector straw training dummy rendered to transparent WebP. Inanimate standalone stage character. Paired choreography moves its whole body; no human facial or limb rig.

Watcher.name: 旁边的人 · Onlooker
Watcher.provenance: Original fictional passing player for LMS episode 7; shared polished SVG rig, not official art.

sources: Personal simplified Mandarin adaptation of NAM Heesung, The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Book 1 Chapter 2, user-supplied first-compilation EPUB. From the instructor meeting Weed through the first strength increase after six hours and the first stats window. Stops before the next five-hour passage. Not an official translation.

Instructor guidance, wooden practice sword, farthest dummy, repeated uninterrupted training, onlookers, six hours to +1 strength, level 1 and strength 11 stay fixed. Two small reconnecting choices affect inner reflections only; all callbacks are within this episode.

Training dummy is an original vector illustration embedded as a static character with finite base-anchored sway after sword contact. Six finite sequences (twelve strikes if watched to completion) accompany Mandarin lines and represent continuous practice, not a real-time six-hour loop. The standard visible sword is stylized, not a material-accurate wooden-sword asset; the story preserves the wooden practice weapon. Hyun retains the approved design rather than depicting the book’s white starter outfit. The hall is original generated scenery.

Directing revision v3 adds fitted two-shots, listener close-ups, action framing, optional original procedural room tone and sword impacts, and subtle dust. Mandarin, glosses, audio, choices and source events are unchanged from v2. Sound starts off; reduced motion removes environmental movement.
